input.quote: (a) Royalty Rates for Royalties Payable by Sanofi on Net Sales outside the United States. Subject to the other terms of this Section 9.3, during the Royalty Term, Sanofi shall make quarterly royalty payments to RevMed on aggregate Net Sales of each Product sold outside the United States during a Calendar Year at the applicable royalty rates as set forth below.
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation obligation burdens Sanofi anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for MFN, "most favored/favoured", "no less favorable" and third-party term-matching language return nothing; the financial provisions (Article IX) set fixed royalty rates, tiered milestones, royalty reductions and a Royalty Floor, with no obligation for Sanofi to extend RevMed terms given to any third party or to match a third-party offer. The only third-party-comparison mechanic is the SHP1-SHP2 Dual Inhibitor right of first negotiation in Section 3.5(b), which runs in Sanofi's favour (RevMed must notify us and negotiate exclusively before dealing with a third party) and so is welcome under this rule. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer); no redline required.
